[`ess/http.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/a2a/blob/main/ess/http.yaml) binds operations of the specification to A2A's HTTP+JSON paths (`ess-http/1`), and `ess generate --kind openapi --http` projects it to [`generated/openapi-http/openapi/a2a-agent.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/a2a/blob/main/generated/openapi-http/openapi/a2a-agent.yaml). `task check` holds that document's (method, path) pairs to [`upstream/openapi/a2a.openapi.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/a2a/blob/main/upstream/openapi/a2a.openapi.yaml), the paths A2A's `a2a.proto` declares, and fails on a difference [`ess/http-unmapped.tsv`](https://github.com/beyond10x/a2a/blob/main/ess/http-unmapped.tsv) does not name, or on a named one that no longer differs.

9 of A2A's 22 routes are served at their path. The other 13 are listed below with the reason ESS cannot serve them there, and so are the 12 projected routes that are not A2A's.

## Served at A2A's path

| Method | Path | Operation |
|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/message:send` | command [`a2a.tasks.SendMessage`](./specification/a2a-tasks.md#sendmessage) |
| `POST` | `/message:stream` | command [`a2a.tasks.SendStreamingMessage`](./specification/a2a-tasks.md#sendstreamingmessage) |
| `GET` | `/tasks/{id}` | command [`a2a.tasks.GetTask`](./specification/a2a-tasks.md#gettask) |
| `GET` | `/tasks` | view [`a2a.tasks.Tasks`](./specification/a2a-tasks.md#tasks) |
| `POST` | `/tasks/{taskId}/pushNotificationConfigs` | command [`a2a.tasks.CreateTaskPushNotificationConfig`](./specification/a2a-tasks.md#createtaskpushnotificationconfig) |
| `GET` | `/tasks/{taskId}/pushNotificationConfigs/{id}` | command [`a2a.tasks.GetTaskPushNotificationConfig`](./specification/a2a-tasks.md#gettaskpushnotificationconfig) |
| `GET` | `/tasks/{taskId}/pushNotificationConfigs` | command [`a2a.tasks.ListTaskPushNotificationConfigs`](./specification/a2a-tasks.md#listtaskpushnotificationconfigs) |
| `DELETE` | `/tasks/{taskId}/pushNotificationConfigs/{id}` | command [`a2a.tasks.DeleteTaskPushNotificationConfig`](./specification/a2a-tasks.md#deletetaskpushnotificationconfig) |
| `GET` | `/extendedAgentCard` | command [`a2a.discovery.GetExtendedAgentCard`](./specification/a2a-discovery.md#getextendedagentcard) |

|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/{tenant}/extendedAgentCard` | UNMAPPED (ESS gap): the /{tenant}/ additional binding; ESS-HTTP-005 an operation has one route, ESS-HTTP-009 Optional\<String\> tenant cannot be a path segment, ESS-HTTP-011 since a literal takes no precedence over a variable: overlaps get /tasks/{id} (ess/http.yaml) |
| `POST` | `/{tenant}/message:send` | UNMAPPED (ESS gap): the /{tenant}/ additional binding; ESS-HTTP-005 an operation has one route, ESS-HTTP-009 Optional\<String\> tenant cannot be a path segment (ess/http.yaml) |

| `GET` | `/{tenant}/tasks` | UNMAPPED (ESS gap): the /{tenant}/ additional binding; ESS-HTTP-005 an operation has one route, ESS-HTTP-009 Optional\<String\> tenant cannot be a path segment, ESS-HTTP-011 since a literal takes no precedence over a variable: overlaps get /tasks/{id} (ess/http.yaml) |
| `GET` | `/{tenant}/tasks/{id}` | UNMAPPED (ESS gap): the /{tenant}/ additional binding; ESS-HTTP-005 an operation has one route, ESS-HTTP-009 Optional\<String\> tenant cannot be a path segment, ESS-HTTP-011 since a literal takes no precedence over a variable: overlaps get /tasks/{taskId}/pushNotificationConfigs and get /views/tasks/pushNotificationConfigs (ess/http.yaml) |
| `POST` | `/{tenant}/tasks/{id}:cancel` | UNMAPPED (ESS gap): the /{tenant}/ additional binding; ESS-HTTP-005 an operation has one route, ESS-HTTP-009 Optional\<String\> tenant cannot be a path segment, ESS-HTTP-007 {id}:verb is not a whole variable (ess/http.yaml) |
| `GET` | `/{tenant}/tasks/{id}:subscribe` | UNMAPPED (ESS gap): the /{tenant}/ additional binding; ESS-HTTP-005 an operation has one route, ESS-HTTP-009 Optional\<String\> tenant cannot be a path segment, ESS-HTTP-007 {id}:verb is not a whole variable (ess/http.yaml) |
| `GET` | `/{tenant}/tasks/{taskId}/pushNotificationConfigs` | UNMAPPED (ESS gap): the /{tenant}/ additional binding; ESS-HTTP-005 an operation has one route, ESS-HTTP-009 Optional\<String\> tenant cannot be a path segment, ESS-HTTP-011 since a literal takes no precedence over a variable: overlaps get /tasks/{taskId}/pushNotificationConfigs/{id} (ess/http.yaml) |
| `POST` | `/{tenant}/tasks/{taskId}/pushNotificationConfigs` | UNMAPPED (ESS gap): the /{tenant}/ additional binding; ESS-HTTP-005 an operation has one route, ESS-HTTP-009 Optional\<String\> tenant cannot be a path segment (ess/http.yaml) |
| `GET` | `/{tenant}/tasks/{taskId}/pushNotificationConfigs/{id}` | UNMAPPED (ESS gap): the /{tenant}/ additional binding; ESS-HTTP-005 an operation has one route, ESS-HTTP-009 Optional\<String\> tenant cannot be a path segment (ess/http.yaml) |
| `DELETE` | `/{tenant}/tasks/{taskId}/pushNotificationConfigs/{id}` | UNMAPPED (ESS gap): the /{tenant}/ additional binding; ESS-HTTP-005 an operation has one route, ESS-HTTP-009 Optional\<String\> tenant cannot be a path segment (ess/http.yaml) |

## Projected routes that are not A2A's

| Method | Path | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/tasks/commands/tasks:cancel` | Stand-in for UNMAPPED post /tasks/{id}:cancel: derived route of a2a.tasks.CancelTask (ESS-HTTP-007) |
| `POST` | `/tasks/commands/tasks:subscribe` | Stand-in for UNMAPPED get /tasks/{id}:subscribe: derived route of a2a.tasks.SubscribeToTask (ESS-HTTP-007) |
| `POST` | `/tasks/commands/tasks:complete` | Not an A2A operation: agent-side lifecycle command (ess/domains/tasks.yaml), on its derived route |
| `POST` | `/tasks/commands/tasks:fail` | Not an A2A operation: agent-side lifecycle command (ess/domains/tasks.yaml), on its derived route |
| `POST` | `/tasks/commands/tasks:reject` | Not an A2A operation: agent-side lifecycle command (ess/domains/tasks.yaml), on its derived route |
| `POST` | `/tasks/commands/tasks:require_auth` | Not an A2A operation: agent-side lifecycle command (ess/domains/tasks.yaml), on its derived route |
| `POST` | `/tasks/commands/tasks:require_input` | Not an A2A operation: agent-side lifecycle command (ess/domains/tasks.yaml), on its derived route |
| `POST` | `/tasks/commands/tasks:update_artifact` | Not an A2A operation: agent-side lifecycle command (ess/domains/tasks.yaml), on its derived route |
| `POST` | `/tasks/commands/tasks:work` | Not an A2A operation: agent-side lifecycle command (ess/domains/tasks.yaml), on its derived route |
| `GET` | `/tasks/views/allPushNotificationConfigs` | Not an A2A operation: observation view (ess/domains/tasks.yaml views), on its derived route |
| `GET` | `/tasks/views/allTasks` | Not an A2A operation: observation view (ess/domains/tasks.yaml views), on its derived route |
| `GET` | `/views/tasks/pushNotificationConfigs` | Not an A2A operation: view a2a.tasks.TaskPushNotificationConfigs, moved off its derived route, which overlaps get /tasks/{taskId}/pushNotificationConfigs (ESS-HTTP-011) |
